name: rescan-keeps-what-was-already-read
find:
if "unread_pages" not in rescanned:
        merged["unread_pages"] = was_unread
        merged["unread_page_numbers"] = was_numbered or [
            NO_PAGE_NUMBER for _ in was_unread]
        return merged
replace:
if False:
        merged["unread_pages"] = was_unread
        merged["unread_page_numbers"] = was_numbered or [
            NO_PAGE_NUMBER for _ in was_unread]
        return merged
breaks: a rescan that fell over and reported nothing is read as having read everything, so the warning naming the missing pages is cleared on the strength of a failure and Dan is told the programme is complete when it is not (#518)
